# condepe

R access to the open data of the **Observatório de Pernambuco**,
published by [Condepe/Fidem](https://cf.pe.gov.br) (the Pernambuco State
Agency for Planning and Research): municipal series on population,
economy, public finance, labour, education, health, security, transport
and environment for the 185 municipalities of Pernambuco, Brazil.

Every source is published in the same long format (one observation per
row, 15 columns), so one set of functions covers all of them, returning
tibbles.

## Installation

``` r

# Not yet on CRAN; for now:
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("StrategicProjects/condepe-r")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(condepe)

# Sources available (one row each), with the catalogue version
cat <- condepe_catalog()
attr(cat, "version")

# Indicators of a source
condepe_indicators("sidra_populacao_estimada")

# A series: Recife (IBGE 2611606), 2020 onwards
condepe_series(
  "sidra_populacao_estimada", "Populacao residente estimada",
  code = "2611606", years = 2020:2026
)

# A whole source, and the municipality list
condepe_data("datasus_sinasc")
condepe_localities()
```

Column names are kept in Portuguese, as published, so results stay
traceable to the official files: `cd_municipio_ibge`, `nm_municipio`,
`ano`, `mes`, `indicador`, `indicador_base`, `valor`, `unidade`,
`natureza`, `id_fonte`, `eixo`, `tema`, `assunto`, `fonte_original`,
`arquivo_origem`. Monthly series carry the period in `indicador`
(`"... [MM/YYYY]"`) and `mes`; `indicador_base` is the label without it.

## Where the data come from

- **Canonical:** <https://cf.pe.gov.br/observatorio/dados/atual/>
- **Mirror (fallback):** the Hugging Face dataset
  [`mlkwy/observatorio-pernambuco`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/mlkwy/observatorio-pernambuco),
  with the same relative paths.

Files are cached on disk per catalogue version
([`condepe_cache_dir()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/reference/condepe_cache_dir.md))
and checked against the SHA-256 published in the catalogue; the
catalogue itself is trusted for 6 hours. If neither backend answers,
functions warn and return a zero-row tibble with the documented columns.
Options are listed in
[`?condepe`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/reference/condepe-package.md).

Documentation: <https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/>.

## Citation and license

Data: Condepe/Fidem, *Observatório de Pernambuco — Base de Dados do
Estado*, [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The
citation with the version in use is in
`attr(condepe_catalog(), "citation")`.

Code: MIT. To read or write *private* buckets on `s3.pe.gov.br` with an
access key, see [`s3pe`](https://github.com/StrategicProjects/s3pe);
`condepe` needs no key, since the Observatory open data are public. A
Python package with the same functions is [`condepe` for
Python](https://github.com/StrategicProjects/condepe-py).

# Package index

## Discover

What the Observatory publishes, and where.

- [`condepe_catalog()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/reference/condepe_catalog.md)
  : List the sources published by the Observatory
- [`condepe_indicators()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/reference/condepe_indicators.md)
  : List the indicators of a source
- [`condepe_localities()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/reference/condepe_localities.md)
  : Municipalities of Pernambuco and the State, with IBGE codes

## Retrieve data

- [`condepe_series()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/reference/condepe_series.md)
  : Series of one or more indicators
- [`condepe_data()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/reference/condepe_data.md)
  : Download a whole source

## Cache and options

- [`condepe_cache_dir()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/reference/condepe_cache_dir.md)
  [`condepe_cache_clear()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/reference/condepe_cache_dir.md)
  : Cache directory used by condepe
- [`condepe`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/reference/condepe-package.md)
  [`condepe-package`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/reference/condepe-package.md)
  : condepe: Access the Open Data of the Pernambuco Observatory
